name: Freytag's Pyramid
description: A five-stage dramatic arc that rises to a climax and falls to a close.

beats.title: Exposition
beats.note: Establish the characters, setting and starting situation.

beats.title: Rising Action
beats.note: Build tension through a series of events that deepen the conflict.

beats.title: Climax
beats.note: Reach the turning point where the conflict peaks.

beats.title: Falling Action
beats.note: Show the results of the climax as the tension eases.

beats.title: Dénouement
beats.note: Tie off the remaining threads and show the new normal.
